tags: [FACT] measured by the detector at the locator | [DERIVED] the detector's fix direction, advisory | [NORM] rule for the agent | [NULL] measured as nothing
self_falsifier: each item is bound_to sha256 of its file; void_if sha256(file) != bound_to -> the item is VOID: HOLD it, do not repair from this document, re-scan
verify_step: bound_to MATCH, channel COMPLETE or MEASURED, then the rule's question (RULES) on the code shown
hold_if: the file's SHA-256 differs from source_sha256
the item's channel state is not MEASURED or COMPLETE
hard_stop: the fix needs a FORBID change -> stop, REPORT HOLD
the fix changes a public signature, a return type or code outside the item's span -> stop, needs a decision (D-*)
running code from the analyzed repository without an approved test profile
a REPORT field filled with placeholder text instead of NOT-MEASURED
forbid: a suppression comment or a noqa / pragma marker
a threshold, weight or config change
deleting or renaming the function to make the item vanish
invariants: score != review candidates: the score comes from the pattern channel only; a candidate never moves it
FINDING != proven defect; REVIEW_CANDIDATE != defect: both are decided in VERIFY
REJECT with evidence is a result, not a failure: it is the false-alarm channel
allowed: A-01 read any file of the target
A-02 edit inside the item's span
A-03 add or change a test that proves the fix
A-04 claim_without_mechanism: reword the docstring to what the function does
D-01 decision first: split a function across files, merge clones across modules
D-02 decision first: add or change a dependency declaration

prove.suggestion: re-scan the item's file with the same configuration
prove.expect: PASS needs prove_state FIXED_CANDIDATE and the project's tests passing, with no new item. prove_state: HOLD when the item's symbol is gone; PERSISTS when its id is still there, or its semantic_key is under another id as often as before (moved: a locator is an address in one snapshot); FIXED_CANDIDATE only when its semantic_key and its cause_key are both left fewer times and every other item sharing them kept its id, or none is left; HOLD when its cause_key is still there as often as before (reworded) or the match is ambiguous

verify.FINDING: check the evidence at file:line; ACK and fix, or REJECT with the reason it does not apply
verify.REVIEW_CANDIDATE: decide whether a real effect or use is expected here; if yes fix, if no REJECT with the reason

claim.rules_line: is the docstring promise kept? The item block states what the body needs
claim.question: the body needs {looked_for}; found: {why}. ACK: {resolves}; REJECT: name the mechanism the detector missed (file:line)

size.question: Does the function do more than one job? ACK if it splits into named steps with the same behavior; REJECT if it is one job laid out flat (a table, a dispatch, a fixed sequence).

escape.question: Is the silenced warning a real defect here? ACK: fix the cause and drop the marker; REJECT: the marker is narrow (one code) and the reason is stated beside it.

placeholder.question: Do callers get the behavior the name and docstring promise? ACK: implement it or say in the code what is intended; REJECT: the body is the whole contract (a declared default, a registered no-op, an abstract hook) and that is stated.

exception.question: Can the caller tell that the operation failed? ACK: handle, re-raise or report the failure; REJECT: the failure is expected, harmless and the handler says why.

dependency.question: Does a clean install provide this import at runtime? ACK: declare it or guard it with the documented fallback; REJECT: name the declaration or guard that provides it (file:line).

clone.question: Must the copies change together? ACK: keep one and call it; REJECT: they are meant to diverge (name the difference that will appear).

input.question: Should the value change the result or an effect? ACK: use it or remove it from the signature with its callers; REJECT: the signature is fixed by a caller or protocol (name it).

hollow.question: Does the reported success reflect work that happened? ACK: perform the effect or report the real outcome; REJECT: name the effect the detector could not see (file:line).
